responsibility: This file is the CHECKING_P selftest translation unit for the typed_splay_tree wrapper defined in typed-splay-tree.h. It constructs a simple typed key/value tree and verifies lookup, removal, predecessor/successor navigation, min/max queries, and inorder foreach traversal, serving purely as validation coverage for the typed splay-tree API rather than implementing the tree algorithms themselves.
same_name_distinction: Serves solely as the CHECKING_P selftest file for typed_splay_tree, validating lookup, removal, predecessor/successor, min/max, and traversal; the splay-tree wrapper implementation is in gcc/typed-splay-tree.h.
